where: The Old Seams (the sealed deep galleries under Cinderhead: plank bridges, ore-cart rails, the first fallen star asleep below)
mood: Abandoned deep galleries: rails and dripping water in the dark, and something vast breathing slowly far below.
_motif_note: Low strength, the cave treatment (as cinderhead-mine-a, its parent cue, which held 80 BPM conditioned).
_stall_note: deliberately sparse deep cave: silence between the breaths is part of the cue (dead_air.py allows up to max_stall)
core_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
C sharp minor with a dark Phrygian flat second
a low hollow pulse-wave lead moving slowly by steps
deep slow bass swells that rise and fall like enormous breathing
sparse high plinks like water dripping in a cavern
distant dry pick-taps and the faint clack of old rails
a dark warm organ pad far in the background
abandoned deep mine galleries in total darkness, ancient and vast

sections.name: Intro
sections.text: {a lone drip echoes down the shaft, then the deep breath swells up from below for the first time}

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {the low hollow lead sounds only a rising leap and holds it, unresolved, over the slow breathing bass; drips and pick-taps in the silences}

sections.name: Main Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the leap again, sinking a half step onto the dark flat second; the organ pad glows faintly beneath, the breath a little deeper}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast, the rail yard: a slow ticking rail-clack ostinato, the lead falls quiet, and the vast breath swells louder and closer}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the low lead returns over the breathing bass and drips; the last bar leads straight back into the main theme}
styles: seamless loop back to the start of the theme
